question: Which full attention heads and MLP modules generate the now weight-compiled downstream response coordinates?

frozen_program.population: all 99 attention heads in layers 0-10 and all 11 MLPs in layers 0-10, patched one complete component at a time
frozen_program.coordinate_target: four local-current attention c_v/Q responses plus four rank-64 MLP residual-input/Q responses
frozen_program.score: sum of absolute signed projections onto all eight full compiled coordinate tensors
frozen_program.causal_crosscheck: native final answer-margin projection under the same single-component patches
frozen_program.joint_arm: the top 20 components by frozen coordinate score

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_self_patch_fi: authorities replay, full-component self patch is inert, all statistics are finite, and <=128 forwards execute
predictions.pred_b_compiled_coordinate_instrument_cl: the reconstructed full compiled coordinate tensors retain the already validated target program and are nonzero for all eight sites
predictions.pred_c_known_response_frontier_is_enrich: at least four of L8H1, L9H1, L9H4, MLP1, MLP3, MLP4, and MLP6 occur in the coordinate top 20
predictions.pred_d_compiled_coordinate_incidence_pre: single-site coordinate magnitude and native final-margin magnitude have Spearman correlation >=0.50
predictions.pred_e_top20_joint_patch_is_coordinate_s: the top-20 joint patch attains signed projection >=0.80 on every downstream compiled coordinate with aggregate coordinate residual <=0.20

decision: Use the top pool—not all native-effectful sites—as the search space for a subsequent complete-family greedy and control-tested upstream program. Failure redirects scoring to task-conditioned coordinate blocks rather than final-output greediness.
